title: Twist E19: Indecomposable gluing, a genus-2 curve and explicit maps
status_note: Partial local evidence, 2026-10-23; full experiment blocked and unfunded. Four parameter presentations per source and explicit degree-three maps pass native/PARI checks. Toy divisor transfer and 24 distinct source-verified destination recoveries pass. Polarized graph identification, second-map transfer, formal bridges and full costs remain open. Raw publication is verified in setec-astronomy-artifacts (2026-10-25): fresh download, all member hashes and frozen incidence CAS replay pass. The earlier denials targeted the wrong bucket.
blocked_on: note:Four parameter presentations per source and explicit degree-three maps pass native/PARI checks. Toy divisor transfer and 24 distinct source-verified destination recoveries pass. Polarized graph identification, second-map transfer, formal bridges and full costs remain open.
question: Does an E18 anti-isometry yield an indecomposably principally polarized quotient with an explicit same-field genus-2 model and subgroup transfer?
decision_value: A fully checked toy model becomes an E24 arithmetic input and a future destination-solver input. A failed anti-isometry closes only that candidate. P-521 construction success remains a public-parameter result, with no NIST DLP execution.

resources.notes: Proposed pilot: one CPU, 4 GiB and 3,600 seconds per anti-isometry. Stop that cell on a singular model, failed descent, failed map identity or resource cap; retain the failed certificate. Full resources remain unestimated. The nominal disk field is not an estimate; calibrate and freeze it before readiness.
